tasks.title: Stand up the Vitest + Testing Library test harness
acceptance_criteria: Adds Vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, and jsdom as devDependencies.
Adds a `test` script (`vitest run`) and a `test:watch` script to package.json.
Adds `vitest.config.js` with the React plugin, `environment: 'jsdom'`, and a global setup file; no change to build/dev behavior.
Adds `src/test/setup.js` importing `@testing-library/jest-dom` and providing a default `window.matchMedia` stub (overridable per test).
`npm run test` runs and reports 0 tests (or only passing tests) with no config errors.
tests: `npm run test` exits 0 with the harness in place.
`npm run build` still succeeds (test config does not affect the Vite build).
`npm run lint` passes (config/setup files are lint-clean or appropriately ignored).

tasks.title: Animate the 404 page and cover it with a test
acceptance_criteria: Imports the existing `Reveal` default export from `src/components/Reveal.jsx`; adds no new CSS and does not edit `src/index.css`.
Header, central error block, and footer each become a `Reveal` (via `as=`), fading/rising in reading order like `App.jsx`.
The error block's inner items (eyebrow, title, description, button) stagger using the `delay` (`.d1`-`.d4`) prop.
Copy, fonts, `HF.*` colors, spacing, layout, the button hover handlers, and `navigate('/')` are unchanged.
`src/NotFoundPage.test.jsx` renders the page in a MemoryRouter and asserts key copy is present.
The test mocks `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') => matches:true` and asserts the revealed regions render with the `reveal in` class (content visible, not hidden).
tests: NotFoundPage renders 'Page introuvable', the 'Erreur · 404' eyebrow, and the 'Retour aux prévisions' button.
Under mocked reduce-motion, the reveal wrappers carry the `in` class so no region stays at opacity:0.
`npm run test` passes; `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass.
Manual (Verify stage): unknown route fades in header -> error block -> footer; reduce-motion and print show the page fully visible.

out_of_scope: Admin login animations (subtask 02) and admin editor/sidebar animations (subtask 03).
New CSS, keyframes, or edits to src/index.css and the shared motion primitives.
Copy, layout, color, font, or routing changes to the 404 page.
A standalone Reveal unit test (tested here only through the 404 page).
